native_orchestrator.role: babysit-only: classify, plan slices, dispatch, integrate, verify receipts — no bulk coding

next_wave.auto_rule: NEXT-WAVE is a proposal, never execution authority. Render and persist its options; dispatch only after a matching, unexpired human approval receipt confirms the option, plan fingerprint, policy hash, and bounded concurrency.

rules: Before Execute fleet fan-out, prefer a fresh paid-fleet ranking if snapshot is >6h stale.
Seats with remaining_pct < 5 or is_exhausted are hard-ineligible for te-dispatch-paid.
When Claude 5h session remaining < 25%, divert workers to Spark/Cursor/Antigravity-Gemini before Claude Max.
Never put Sol seats in te-dispatch-paid without explicit --include-sol authorization.
Capacity phases (Observe/Think/Plan/Build/Verify/Learn side work) stay on te-reason/te-plan/te-build/te-fast — do not burn Max session on babysit.
Kimi monthly-exhausted seats stay out of paid fleet even if 5h/weekly rate windows look free.
SuperGrok (grok-cli/*) is a paid seat; include via rank-paid-fleet when rem>=20%.
Canonical docs: ~/.temperance_engine/docs/ROUTING.md — Sol-first planning docs archived.
plan-max → te-plan-max (Fable/Sol/Opus); only when complexity signals fire.
Screenshots/settings audits → prefer plan-max + Vision Bridge (gemini/gemini-2.5-flash).
te-plan-max must emit TASK GRAPH + SWARM handoff; never one-round micro-fix as done.
te-swarm-s is capacity fan-out only; never Sol/Fable heads on swarm.
notes: Execute fleet is te-dispatch-paid only (ranked paid seats + SuperGrok).
Capacity phases stay on te-reason/te-plan/te-build/te-fast — do not burn Sol/Fable as silent defaults.
Sol/Fable/Opus are explicit pins when user wants max creative/planning spend.
Legacy Sol-first docs archived under docs/archive/*-pre-routing-cleanup/

forbidden_on_orchestrator: Do not implement multi-file changes in the native session when a combo is recommended.
Do not use legacy te-dispatch; use te-dispatch-paid.
Do not pin Sol as worker fleet head without explicit authorization.
Do not pin exhausted Antigravity Claude seats when quota_snapshots show remaining 0.
Do not burn Claude Max 5h session on capacity-class side-quests (use te-fast).

missing_or_broken: perplexity-search (needs Search API key, not perplexity-web session)

modes.temperance-algorithm: pin te-algorithm; Plan slices may hard-route te-plan-max when task_type=plan-max
modes.temperance-planner: complexity-aware: te-plan or te-plan-max from classify-task.sh

algorithm_phases_notes: Default Plan phase uses te-plan. When classifier returns plan-max (complex ALGORITHM planning), use te-plan-max instead.

commands.swarm_batch: temperance-batch with model te-swarm-s for capacity slices
commands.paid_batch: temperance-batch with te-dispatch-paid for paid implement

skill_discovery: For each capability gap, run temperance-discover-skills.sh
Prefer local skill-clusters hubs/spokes before marketplace
SkillsMP via OmniRoute when local miss (skillsProvider=skillsmp)
Install public skills only with user approval; then re-tier + gen-index

skills.plan_max_rule: On te-plan/te-plan-max deep pass, emit SKILL GAPS in TASK GRAPH with resolve path local|skillsmp|install
